name: chuwu-pros-five
description: Fourteen evidence-aware PR, research and knowledge-maintenance workflows curated by Chuwu.

displayDescription.zh: 整合十四项公关、研究与知识维护方法，支持舆情研判、文案审查、研究设计和通稿写作，明确证据边界。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Choose the appropriate PR or research workflow for my materials and goal, then complete the task.
